title: Support Anthropic's Native MCP Connector API (mcp_servers parameter)
body:
### Description

Anthropic recently released an MCP Connector feature that allows Claude's Messages API to connect directly to remote MCP servers via the mcp_servers parameter (requires anthropic-beta: mcp-client-2025-04-04 header).

Adding support for Anthropic's native connector would enable:
  - Direct MCP server connections via Claude's Messages API
  - OAuth bearer token authentication for MCP servers
  - Multiple simultaneous MCP server connections
  - Tool access without local MCP client implementation

Reference: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/mcp-connector

### AI SDK Version

"ai": "^5.0.59",
"@ai-sdk/anthropic": "^2.0.22",
